# Roof racks and crossbars

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

## Summary

_No verified summary yet._

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Every step below is supported by the source, but the verifier could not confirm this is the whole procedure. Steps or precautions may be missing; read the source thread before relying on it.

1. Mount the golf cart roof rack to the vehicle using custom brackets designed for specific roof styles.
2. Drill holes into the existing factory roof rack as needed to accommodate the mounting points.

_Procedure reported by [t40]._

## Tools

- Speed square [t40]
- Punch [t40]

## Parts

- Bike tube: Used as an inner liner for the Ubolt housing/bracket [t40]
- Golf cart drop-in roof rack, e.g., RHOX Garvin style: Heavy duty black powder coated steel, measures 5"H x 32"W x 52"L [t40]
- Vibration-damping U-bolts: Ordered from McMaster-Carr [t40]
- WD-40: To help seat the vibration damping bolts [t40]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use a speed square to find centers and a punch to create dimples before drilling. [t40]
- Apply WD-40 to get the Ubolts through the drilled holes in the rack. [t40]
